body: Would have updated proposal but i opened this CW account (at the beginning) by email which had an address attached to it automatically. Now that address no longer seems part of that email. Else i would have made **parachain startup planning** more of the title.

fyi, I dont really spend a lot of time on commonwealth, but this grant was resolved a long time ago. The last 15 months i have made 2 grant proposals, serving most of my time in Edgeware without funding, with the aim of creative upfront value and capturing value in the future.  

The way I capture EDG for the value myself and Decentration provides will be improved, more likely to be invoices, and/or request for vested stake in EDG.

This grant changed to focus more on parachain and relay chain over bridge when Thom Ivy requested that I focus on parachain ~12 months ago. 

- Researched, developed, collaborated about relay and parachains, over a longer period than 13 weeks (closer to 26 weeks), with key stakeholders, planning and refining the launch of a parachain (Kabocha).
- The honus moved away from bridges to multichain, parachain development. 
- Once parachain is launched we can explore bridges (in a different milestone).


Plenty of floors have been swept.
We need delivery updates on this.

[@Decentration](/edgeware/account/mHDNswFgLQiiXGwkWCXgpwE27eppYppa96cMNWzT2kQF27z) 

 guessing these are the ones from the objectives that need updates:

> Parabridge Research, Viability Study and Testing 
> Deployment and testing of the Bridge Common palette, enabling inter-Substrate communication. 
> Substrate chain partners: Bridge with 5 other established chains in the Substrate ecosystem (e.g. phala, akala, kusama, moonbeam… etc.)

Thanks [@Ramsey](/edgeware/account/k44nJ5yAhFz3XHGeTPuKvegJ4GD1YCSVaPc7wj4miVL6epN). That sounds good. They've already implemented several bridges, including substrate to Ethereum, TRON, HECO, and have BSC and others in the works (including a substrate-substrate bridge) using a super-light client. I know they're also developing capability for cross-chain NFT functionality (apparently coming in the next 1-2 months). It sounds like it might be worth talking to them about integration, if it makes sense from a dev perspective.

[@R J](/edgeware/account/nQAzQgSyAey4He1JFhkSeGvitDd3zwnosKbJoyBDWkQ1fpq) hi, thanks for your thoughts. You're correct if Darwinia have already set up their bridge they would be a great substrate chain to bridge with. I believe they're using the parity-bridge-common pallet, (but will have a closer look), and we will also use parity-bridge-common pallet on our side to enable the magic to happen.
[@Ramsey](/edgeware/account/k44nJ5yAhFz3XHGeTPuKvegJ4GD1YCSVaPc7wj4miVL6epN) see above from [@R J](/edgeware/account/nQAzQgSyAey4He1JFhkSeGvitDd3zwnosKbJoyBDWkQ1fpq)

I know I missed the discussion period, but I'm still curious as to whether it might be possible to collaborate with Darwinia and use their bridge tech? My (admittedly limited) understanding is that they've got noncustodial bridges already operational to bridge substrate-based and other chains.
